label: Simulation: M3 pressure-wave method on a 150 m PE pipe (not measured on the bench)

cases.title: Leak 115 m from the sensor
cases.story: A far leak: its echo returns after 0.66 s.

cases.title: Leak 60 m from the sensor
cases.story: Mid-pipe leak: echo after 0.34 s, time reversal focuses on it.

cases.title: Leak 15 m from the sensor
cases.story: A near leak: the echo returns only 86 ms after the valve closes.

cases.title: PE pipe with creep, calibrated model
cases.story: The plastic wall absorbs the wave; after one leak-free calibration test the leak is found again.
